title: Generation gets very slow after switching models twice
body:
1. Start with Qwen3 1.7B, chat: about 30 tokens/s
2. Switch to Gemma 4 E2B, chat: about 20 tokens/s
3. Switch back to Qwen3 1.7B: now only 4 tokens/s

Reloading the page fixes it. Looks like the old model stays in GPU memory? M2 Pro, Chrome 141.
author: philippmossier
